name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
description: Adversaries may use a single or small list of commonly used passwords against many different accounts to attempt to acquire valid credentials. Password spraying uses one password (or a small set) against many usernames to avoid account lockouts that would occur when guessing many passwords against one account.
detection: Monitor authentication logs for a single source attempting one password across many accounts within a short time window. A low per-account failure count spread across many accounts is the tell-tale signature.
